title: governance(AGENTS.md PD15): carve the fleet-write relay's refresh stroke out of the release.yml dispatch prohibition
body:
Fixes #23393
Clause-②: no

Executes ruling **A** on #23193: ruling record `6160857949`, the maintainer's word verbatim 「23209 A」, on the options put in `6141962120`. #23193 remains open for PR #23209. #23177 remains open.

**Governed, Tier H** (`AGENTS.md`). This PR stays a draft until an at-tier contract review and an authorized approval. Landing order per the ruling: this PR first, then PR #23209 merges `main`, is re-checked and lands; only then is ruling B item 5 on #23177 (`6139629628`) executable.

## What changes

One clause in the reserved-act list of `AGENTS.md` Prime Directive 15, in the shape option A put to the maintainer ("the reserved act becomes dispatching `release.yml` in any lane except the relay's ... refresh stroke (... `refresh_version_pr: true` alone)"):

- Before: ⛔ `workflow_dispatch`-ing `release.yml` or any other publish-capable workflow,
- After: ⛔ `workflow_dispatch`-ing `release.yml` in any lane but the fleet-write relay's refresh stroke (`refresh_version_pr: true` alone), or any other publish-capable workflow,

The words added are exactly `in any lane but the fleet-write relay's refresh stroke (refresh_version_pr: true alone),` and nothing is deleted. `git diff -w --word-diff` shows that one insertion; the rest of the 9-line hunk is the forced re-flow of the paragraph at its own typeset width (118 B). A whitespace-normalised comparison of the PD15 paragraph at base `4f81f31526` and at head `9b68a60e` is equal to base plus that insertion (`true`; control: the same insertion without its trailing comma answers `false`).

Every other reserved act stays word for word: `changeset publish` / `pnpm run release`, the version tag, the GitHub Release, the runtime image, any other `release.yml` dispatch or input combination, any other publish-capable workflow, the `release` environment approval, and merging, queueing or arming the Version Packages PR.

## True on the `main` it merges into (dependence on PR #23209)

- `WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_INPUTS` is not on `main`: `git grep -c WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_INPUTS origin/main` answers nothing (exit 1) at `4f81f31526`. PR #23209 (head `961ec7100a`) adds it in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` as `'release.yml': { refresh_version_pr: true }`. So the clause states the rule (the relay's stroke, that one input alone) and names no constant.
- On `main` the relay's `WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_ALLOWLIST` is `['shard-timings-refresh.yml']`, and `validate.mjs --self-test` pins that a `release.yml` dispatch is refused naming that list. Between this landing and PR #23209's, the relay refuses the admitted stroke with zero writes: the rule lands before its mechanism and fails closed.
- **This carve-out can be used only once PR #23209 lands.** Nothing here edits `release.yml`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/**` or PR #23209, and nothing was dispatched.

## Why the stroke cannot publish: `release.yml` jobs on `main` (`4f81f31526`)

- `version-pr` (`Version PR maintenance`) runs on `schedule`, or on a dispatch with `inputs.refresh_version_pr` true. It is the only job the stroke starts.
- `release-integrity` (`Release integrity (audit + no-mint backfill)`) and `stale-prompts` (`Cancel publish prompts for versions already on npm`) carry `!inputs.refresh_version_pr` in their own `if:` for a dispatch.
- `full-battery` (`Full battery green at the version commit`) and `publish` (`Publish ... to npm (awaiting approval)`) need `release-integrity`, so a skipped audit makes `success()` false. Their `force` branch also carries `!inputs.refresh_version_pr`.
- `docker` (`Docker image`) has no input guard. It runs only on a `published` output from `release-integrity` or `publish`, and the stroke leaves both unset.

So the card's "the publish lanes require `!inputs.refresh_version_pr`" holds literally for two jobs and on the `force` branch for two more, and `docker` is covered through its dependency. The two dispatches recorded in `6141962120` (runs `38351525685` and `38357219168`) ran `Version PR maintenance` and skipped the other five jobs.

## Line budget: why the ruling's clause and not a three-part sentence

- `AGENTS.md` has a line ceiling of 1116 in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, at headroom 0 on base. Raising it takes a maintainer ruling quoted in the raising PR. Ruling A ruled the text and named no line budget.
- Measured with that gate's own `wrapLine` at the paragraph's typeset width (118 B): the base paragraph greedy-wraps to its current 15 lines, so it has no lossless re-wrap headroom, and its last line has 99 B of slack. The ruling's clause (+91 B) lands in 15 lines, and `AGENTS.md` stays at 1116.
- The three-part sentence the card sketched (the admitted dispatch, the by-job warrant, every other act unchanged; 367 B) measures **+3 lines (1116 to 1119)** and would need its own ruling. Re-wrapping existing text to fund it is refused by the ratchet's header.
- The warrant above is recorded here, not in the rule. PD15's own second paragraph holds that "the YAML is not a barrier that holds against you", so the carve-out's authority is the ruling, and the job guards are only the reason it is safe.

## Reviewer points

1. PD15's bold lead still reads "no AI seat publishes, tags, cuts a Release, or triggers a release workflow". The reserved-act list ("What is reserved is the release act itself: ...") defines the directive and now names the one exception. The lead is unchanged because ruling A amends the clause. A 0-line alignment, if the review wants one: "triggers a release workflow" becomes "triggers a release" (9 B shorter).
2. Mirror check: no file restates PD15's reserved-act list, so nothing moves in step. Queries are listed under Acceptance notes.
3. Prime Directive 13: no ADR reserves the refresh stroke. ADR-0125 line 95 (PD15's "prohibitions stand as written") is the record of 2026-08-20, and it predates `refresh_version_pr`. Nothing is superseded.

## Acceptance notes

- Mirror search over `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `scripts/**` and `docs/**` (git grep -F at `9b68a60e`; control `publish-capable workflow` in `AGENTS.md` = 1 hit). The list phrases `publish-capable workflow`, `publish-capable`, `workflow_dispatch`-ing, `release act itself`, `triggers a release workflow`, `PD15` and pending `release` environment have 0 hits in all four trees. `Prime Directive 15`: `scripts/release-github-releases.mjs` (2 hits, it cites PD15 for not deleting Releases). `Prime Directive #15`: `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (1, a historical ceiling comment), `docs/adr/0125-…` and `docs/adr/0082-…` (7 in total, citations). `refresh_version_pr`: `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` (2) and `docs/releases-maintenance.md` (3, the maintainer's runbook). `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:34` is a pointer ("发布动作的完整清单以 AGENTS.md 为权威"). Pointers do not move, and there is no Tier S hunk.
- The card cites PD15 at `:300-312`. On base it is `:301-321`, and the amended clause is at `:307-308`.

## Gates (head `9b68a60e`)

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; 1 path vs merge base `4f81f3152`, +9 / -9). All 15 derived commands exited 0, and the exit codes were captured before any pipe:
`check-closing-keyword-parity` (and its `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet` ("AGENTS.md is 1116 lines (ceiling 1116; headroom 0)"), `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:required-contexts` and `check:watch-hint-literal`. Two more outside the derivation also exited 0: `check-published-list-mirrors` ("1 published list mirror(s) match") and `check-skills-token-ratchet`. Reconciliation with `--ran`: "15 derived, 15 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", a derived zero. NOT MEASURED: `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --verify-required-set`, which takes a value from the workflow. There is no package build or test, because no package is touched. No changeset: `AGENTS.md` ships in no package's `files[]` (`skip-changeset`).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
AGENTS.md 第 15 条保留动作清单里改了一处:手动派发 `release.yml` 仍由维护者保留,只有一种例外,即经 fleet-write 中继、只带 `refresh_version_pr: true` 的刷新。这次刷新只重生成 Version Packages PR。其余保留动作一字未改,包括发布、打 tag、Release、镜像、`release` 环境审批,以及合并或排队 Version Packages PR。

### 为什么改
执行 #23193 的裁决 A(「23209 A」)。裁决 B 第 5 条要求席位在修复合入后立刻刷新 Version PR,但原文禁止任何 `release.yml` 派发。规则和机制相互矛盾,所以 PR #23209 一直搁置。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
这次刷新不会发布。它只跑 `Version PR maintenance`,审计、发布、镜像任务都跳过,两次实跑可以作证。PR #23209 合入之前,中继会直接拒绝 `release.yml`,例外暂时用不上,失败方向是关闭。行数仍是 1116,不需要抬上限。回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit。

### 席位意见

### 你要做的
批准本 PR(Tier H)。另外请决定首句的「triggers a release workflow」要不要同步改成「triggers a release」(见 Reviewer points 第 1 条),不改也可以。
